Subject: POC kickoff and routing policy working sessions — scheduling

Hi Marissa / Laura / Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme is excited to move into a short POC to validate routing behaviors and run some load tests against our main prompt sets. We want to schedule two things:

1) POC kickoff (30-45m): overview of scope, success criteria, access + SOW questions (we can sign SOW beforehand)
2) Hands-on routing policy working session (90m): prompt review, model selection, fallback rules, region/tiering plan, and a brief load test run

Our team's availability next week (PT):
- Tue Jun 8: 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Jun 9: 09:00–11:00
- Thu Jun 10: 13:00–16:00

Please let us know what works for Redwood and whether you prefer the kickoff and working session on the same day or split. I'm attaching the current POC scope for reference (POC_Scope_v2.pdf).

Thanks,
Karen Li
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
karen@acme.com

Attachment: POC_Scope_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Karen — great to hear. We're aligned on the plan and happy to run both sessions. Proposed Redwood availability (PT):

- Tue Jun 8: Kickoff 10:30–11:00, Working session 11:15–12:45
- Wed Jun 9: Kickoff 09:30–10:00, Working session 10:15–11:45

We can do them back-to-back on Tue Jun 8 if that’s easiest. For the working session, I'll bring Dev (engineering) and Aditya (solutions) to cover model selection and load testing. I attached a draft routing policy doc to seed the conversation (routing_policy_draft.md).

If you want the SOW signed before the kickoff, happy to loop in our legal team — otherwise we can sign right after kickoff pending clarifications.

I can send calendar invites once you confirm the preferred slot.

Thanks,

Thanks Tom/Karen — that schedule works for us. Confirming final plan:

- Tue Jun 8 14:00–14:30 PT: POC kickoff (Marissa, Laura, Stephanie; Karen, Tom) — quick scope, success criteria, SOW signoff
- Thu Jun 10 13:00–14:30 PT: Routing policy working session (Marissa, Aditya, Dev, Laura, Stephanie; Karen, Tom, Acme eng team) — agenda below

Working session agenda (90m):
- 00–10m: Overview of current prompt sets and goals
- 10–35m: Model selection & tiering (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 35–60m: Fallback rules & region routing (SLA targets, cold starts)
- 60–80m: Load test plan and quick warmup run (sample prompts)
- 80–90m: Next steps & action items (SOW sign, access, test tickets)

Action items before Thu Jun 10:
- Acme: share final prompt set (JSON/CSV) by EOD Mon Jun 7
- Redwood: send calendar invites + pre-read (routing_policy_draft.md) and a short infra checklist (API keys, region endpoints)
- Legal/Procurement: Karen to confirm if SOW signing process requires DocuSign or internal PO — if DocuSign, we will send link after kickoff

I've created the invites and added a short pre-read link in the calendar (HubSpot link in thread). If anything changes, we'll reschedule. Looking forward to it.

Best,
